ink.usage: Primary text, borders, modal headers, and filled primary buttons.

paper.usage: Main app background. Technical drafting surface, not editorial beige.

digital-blue.usage: Selection, links, focus, active states, and primary interactive cues.

bauhaus-yellow.usage: Export, active slider thumbs, and ready/action emphasis.

alert-red.usage: Invalid, destructive, and upload CTA emphasis.

display.purpose: Empty-state calls, modal titles, and major workspace moments.

label.purpose: Control labels, section headers, nav labels, and compact metadata.

mono.purpose: Values, coordinates, seeds, snippets, glyph counts, and status chips.

default.usage: All panels, cards, controls, and toolbars at rest.

hardOffset.usage: Top-layer dialogs, selected sample cards, and active draggable layers only.

motion.reducedMotion: Disable non-essential UI animation under prefers-reduced-motion.

layout.desktopShell: Top toolbar, left navigation/layers rail, central preview workspace, right inspector.
layout.mobileShell: Preview first, controls collapsed into tabs or stacked panels.

rules.oneAccent: Blue is for current selection, primary interaction, links, and focus only.
rules.noGradient: No gradients, glass, soft glow, or shadow-as-style.
rules.borderStructure: Use 1px borders for internal structure and 2px borders for selected or primary surfaces.
rules.quietFurniture: Sidebars and inspectors frame the artwork and must not compete with it.

dos: Use mono type for technical values.
Use 150ms ease-out transitions for state changes.
donts: Do not make this look like generic SaaS dashboard UI.
Do not use neon terminal overload.
Do not use beige editorial styling.
Do not add decorative card clutter.
Do not use purple-blue AI gradients.
Do not round controls into pills.
